blocks.text: O'zbek tilida «qilmoq» juda ko'p ishlatiladi: uy vazifasi **qilmoq**, xato **qilmoq**, qaror **qilmoq**, qo'ng'iroq **qilmoq**, xarid **qilmoq**. Ingliz tilida bu ma'no ikki fe'lga bo'linadi: **do** (do — did — done) va **make** (make — made — made). Umumiy qoida: **do** — ish, vazifa, faoliyat (jarayonning o'zi muhim); **make** — yangi narsa yaratish, tayyorlash (natija muhim). Lekin ko'p birikmalar bu qoidaga to'liq bo'ysunmaydi — ularni tayyor holda yodlash kerak.

**do** — biror ishni bajarish. Uy ishlari, o'qish, sport va umuman «vazifa» deb ataladigan narsalar do bilan keladi. Uy ishlarida ko'pincha **the** bor: do **the** shopping, do **the** washing-up, do **the** cleaning. **homework** va **housework** esa artiklsiz: do homework (sanalmaydigan ot — 67-dars).

items.text: Who **does the ironing** in your house?
Lola **is doing a course** in photography.

blocks.text: Harakat aniq aytilmasa — **do** ishlatiladi: What **are** you **doing**? — «Nima qilyapsan?»; I **didn't do anything** — «Hech narsa qilmadim»; **Do something**! — «Biror narsa qil!» **What do you do?** — kasbni so'rash: «Kim bo'lib ishlaysiz?» E'tibor bering: What **do** you **do**? dagi birinchi do — yordamchi fe'l (savol yasaydi), ikkinchisi — asosiy fe'l «qilmoq» (23-dars).

items.text: What **does** your sister **do**? — She's a dentist.

blocks.text: **make** — natijada yangi narsa paydo bo'ladi: make **a cake** (tort pishirmoq), make **tea / coffee** (choy damlamoq / qahva tayyorlamoq), make **breakfast** / **dinner** (nonushta / kechki ovqat tayyorlamoq), make **a dress** (ko'ylak tikmoq), make **a film** (film suratga olmoq), make **a list** (ro'yxat tuzmoq). O'zbekchada har biriga alohida fe'l kerak (pishirmoq, damlamoq, tikmoq, tuzmoq), inglizchada — bitta make. Majhul nisbatda: **made in** China — «Xitoyda ishlab chiqarilgan», **made of** wood — «yog'ochdan yasalgan».

Ba'zi make birikmalari «yaratish» qoidasiga to'liq mos kelmaydi — ularni tayyor holda yodlang: make **a mistake** (xato qilmoq), make **a decision** (qaror qabul qilmoq), make **a phone call** (qo'ng'iroq qilmoq), make **a noise** (shovqin qilmoq), make **friends** (do'stlashmoq), make **money** (pul topmoq), make **the bed** (o'rinni yig'ishtirmoq), make **a mess** (tartibsizlik qilmoq), make **an appointment** (qabulga yozilmoq), make **a plan** (reja tuzmoq), make **a promise** (va'da bermoq), make **progress** (rivojlanmoq). Quyidagi jadvalda do va make birikmalari yonma-yon.

items.text: Try not to **make** the same **mistake** again.
We need to **make a decision** today.
Our new neighbours **make** a lot of **noise**.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «make homework» → **do homework**; «do a mistake» → **make a mistake**; «do a decision» → **make a decision**; «make sport» → **do sport**; «make shopping» → **do the shopping**; «do a call» → **make a call**; «make a photo» → **take a photo**; «make a party» → **have a party** (58-dars).

O'zingizga savol bering: natijada **yangi narsa** paydo bo'ladimi (tort, choy, ro'yxat, shovqin, qaror)? → **make**. Shunchaki ish yoki vazifa **bajariladimi** (uy vazifasi, xarid, tozalash, mashq)? → **do**. Qoidaga mos kelmaydigan iboralarni (make the bed, make a mistake, do a favour) jadvaldan yodlang.

rows: ish, vazifa, faoliyat; aniq aytilmagan harakat
do homework, do the shopping, do sport, What are you doing?
make a cake, make tea, make a mistake, make a decision, make friends

examples.title: **do** the housework: shopping, washing-up, cooking
examples.description: Uy ishlari va uy vazifasi — **do**: do homework, do the housework, do the shopping, do the washing-up, do the cleaning, do the ironing.

sentences.text: I **do the shopping** on Saturday mornings.
sentences.translation: Shanba kuni ertalab **xarid qilaman**.

sentences.text: Who **does the cooking** in your family?
sentences.translation: Oilangizda kim **ovqat pishiradi**?

sentences.text: Have you **done your homework** yet?
sentences.translation: **Uy vazifangizni qilib bo'ldingizmi**?

sentences.text: My husband **does the washing-up** after dinner.
sentences.translation: Erim kechki ovqatdan keyin **idishlarni yuvadi**.

sentences.text: We **do the cleaning** together every Sunday.
sentences.translation: Har yakshanba **uyni** birga **tozalaymiz**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza doesn't like **doing the ironing**.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza **dazmol qilishni** yoqtirmaydi.

sentences.text: Before the guests came, we **did all the housework**.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar kelishidan oldin **hamma uy ishlarini qilib qo'ydik**.

sentences.text: Tom never **does his homework** on time, so the teacher is often angry with him.
sentences.translation: Tom hech qachon **uy vazifasini** o'z vaqtida **qilmaydi**, shuning uchun o'qituvchining unga tez-tez jahli chiqadi.

sentences.text: In our house the children **do the washing**, and the parents **do the cooking**.
sentences.translation: Bizning uyda bolalar **kir yuvadi**, ota-onalar esa **ovqat pishiradi**.

sentences.text: Could you **do some shopping** for Grandma today? She's ill.
sentences.translation: Bugun buvim uchun biroz **xarid qilib bera olasizmi**? U kasal.

examples.title: **do** a job, **do** a course, **do** exercise
examples.description: Ish, o'qish va sport bilan ham **do**: do a job, do a course, do a test, do exercises, do sport / yoga, do your best, do somebody a favour, do well (yaxshi natija ko'rsatmoq).

sentences.text: Bekzod **does** a very hard **job**.
sentences.translation: Bekzod juda og'ir **ishda ishlaydi**.

sentences.text: My sister **is doing a course** in web design.
sentences.translation: Opam veb-dizayn bo'yicha **kursda o'qiyapti**.

sentences.text: Do you **do any sport**? — Yes, I play tennis.
sentences.translation: Biror **sport bilan shug'ullanasizmi**? — Ha, tennis o'ynayman.

sentences.text: Every morning Grandpa **does exercises** in the garden.
sentences.translation: Har kuni ertalab bobom bog'da **badantarbiya qiladi**.

sentences.text: We **did a test** in English yesterday.
sentences.translation: Kecha ingliz tilidan **test topshirdik**.

sentences.text: Don't worry about the result — just **do your best**.
sentences.translation: Natija haqida xavotir olmang — shunchaki **qo'lingizdan kelganini qiling**.

sentences.text: Emma **does yoga** three times a week.
sentences.translation: Emma haftasiga uch marta **yoga bilan shug'ullanadi**.

sentences.text: Next year Aziz wants to **do a master's degree** in Manchester.
sentences.translation: Kelasi yili Aziz Manchesterda **magistraturada o'qimoqchi**.

sentences.text: Can you **do me a favour** and post this letter?
sentences.translation: **Menga bir yaxshilik qilib**, shu xatni jo'natib yuborasizmi?

sentences.text: Madina **did** very **well** in her exams and got a place at university.
sentences.translation: Madina imtihonlarni juda **yaxshi topshirdi** va universitetga kirdi.

examples.title: **do** something / nothing: **What are you doing?**
examples.description: Harakat aniq aytilmasa — **do**: What are you doing? — Nima qilyapsan? I didn't do anything. **What do you do?** — kasbni so'rash («Kim bo'lib ishlaysiz?»).

sentences.text: What **are** you **doing**? — I'm making a salad.
sentences.translation: Nima **qilyapsan**? — Salat tayyorlayapman.

sentences.text: What **do** you **do**? — I'm a nurse.
sentences.translation: **Kim bo'lib ishlaysiz**? — Hamshiraman.

sentences.text: I **didn't do anything** at the weekend — I just relaxed.
sentences.translation: Dam olish kunlari **hech narsa qilmadim** — shunchaki dam oldim.

sentences.text: Is there anything I can **do** to help?
sentences.translation: Yordam berish uchun biror narsa **qila olamanmi**?

sentences.text: What **did** you **do** on your birthday? — We went to a restaurant.
sentences.translation: Tug'ilgan kuningizda nima **qildingiz**? — Restoranga bordik.

sentences.text: Sarah **does a lot** for her elderly neighbours.
sentences.translation: Sara keksa qo'shnilari uchun ko'p **yaxshilik qiladi**.

sentences.text: Don't just sit there — **do something**!
sentences.translation: U yerda shunchaki o'tirmang — **biror narsa qiling**!

sentences.text: I've lost my passport. What **should** I **do**?
sentences.translation: Pasportimni yo'qotib qo'ydim. Nima **qilsam bo'ladi**?

sentences.text: James **hasn't done anything** useful today — he's been on his phone all day.
sentences.translation: Jeyms bugun foydali **hech narsa qilmadi** — butun kun telefonida o'tirdi.

sentences.text: Are you **doing anything** tomorrow evening? — No, why?
sentences.translation: Ertaga kechqurun biror **ish qilyapsizmi**? — Yo'q, nima edi?

examples.title: **make**: food, drinks and things
examples.description: Yangi narsa yaratilsa yoki tayyorlansa — **make**: make a cake, make tea, make breakfast, make a dress, make a film. O'zbekchada «pishirmoq», «damlamoq», «tikmoq», «yasamoq».

sentences.text: Shall I **make** some tea? — Yes, please.
sentences.translation: **Choy damlaymi**? — Ha, iltimos.

sentences.text: My mother **makes** the best plov in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Onam Toshkentdagi eng mazali palovni **pishiradi**.

sentences.text: Grandma **made** this dress for me when I was ten.
sentences.translation: Bu ko'ylakni buvim o'n yoshimda menga **tikib bergan**.

sentences.text: Emma is **making** a birthday cake for her son.
sentences.translation: Emma o'g'liga tug'ilgan kun **tortini pishiryapti**.

sentences.text: These chairs **were made** by my grandfather.
sentences.translation: Bu stullarni bobom **yasagan**.

sentences.text: I **made** a list of things to buy for the trip.
sentences.translation: Safar uchun sotib olinadigan narsalar **ro'yxatini tuzdim**.

sentences.text: Who **made** this delicious soup? It's wonderful!
sentences.translation: Bu mazali sho'rvani kim **pishirdi**? Ajoyib!

sentences.text: Every morning Aziz **makes** breakfast for the whole family.
sentences.translation: Har kuni ertalab Aziz butun oilaga **nonushta tayyorlaydi**.

sentences.text: The students **are making** a short film about their city.
sentences.translation: Talabalar o'z shaharlari haqida qisqa **film suratga olishyapti**.

sentences.text: Excuse me, is this bag **made** of real leather?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bu sumka haqiqiy charmdan **qilinganmi**?

examples.title: **make** a mistake, a decision, a phone call
examples.description: make bilan eng muhim turg'un iboralar: make a mistake (xato qilmoq), make a decision (qaror qabul qilmoq), make a phone call (qo'ng'iroq qilmoq), make a plan (reja tuzmoq), make an appointment (qabulga yozilmoq).

sentences.text: Everybody **makes mistakes** — don't worry.
sentences.translation: Hamma **xato qiladi** — xavotir olmang.

sentences.text: Sorry, I have to **make** an important phone **call**.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, muhim bir **qo'ng'iroq qilishim** kerak.

sentences.text: You **made** only two **mistakes** in your test. Well done!
sentences.translation: Testda bor-yo'g'i ikkita **xato qildingiz**. Barakalla!

sentences.text: Have you **made a decision** about the new job?
sentences.translation: Yangi ish bo'yicha **qaror qabul qildingizmi**?

sentences.text: I'd like to **make an appointment** with Dr Karimova.
sentences.translation: Doktor Karimova **qabuliga yozilmoqchiman**.

sentences.text: We **made plans** for the summer holiday last night.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun yozgi ta'til uchun **reja tuzdik**.

sentences.text: It was a hard decision, but Bekzod **made** the right **choice**.
sentences.translation: Bu qiyin qaror edi, lekin Bekzod to'g'ri **tanlov qildi**.

sentences.text: My son **made a promise** to help me in the garden.
sentences.translation: O'g'lim menga bog'da yordam berishga **va'da berdi**.

sentences.text: Why **did** you **make** that **decision** without asking me?
sentences.translation: Nega mendan so'ramay o'sha **qarorni qabul qildingiz**?

sentences.text: Sarah **made a complaint** because the hotel room was dirty.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona xonasi iflos bo'lgani uchun Sara **shikoyat qildi**.

examples.title: **make** a noise, friends, money, the bed
examples.description: Yana make iboralari: make a noise (shovqin qilmoq), make friends (do'stlashmoq), make money (pul topmoq), make the bed (o'rinni yig'ishtirmoq), make a mess (tartibsizlik qilmoq), make progress (rivojlanmoq).

sentences.text: Please don't **make** so much **noise** — the baby's asleep.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, bunchalik **shovqin qilmang** — chaqaloq uxlayapti.

sentences.text: Lola **makes friends** very easily.
sentences.translation: Lola juda oson **do'stlashadi**.

sentences.text: Do you **make** your **bed** every morning?
sentences.translation: Har kuni ertalab **o'rningizni yig'ishtirasizmi**?

sentences.text: James **makes** a lot of **money** as a lawyer.
sentences.translation: Jeyms advokat bo'lib ko'p **pul topadi**.

sentences.text: The children **made a mess** in the kitchen.
sentences.translation: Bolalar oshxonani **ostin-ustun qilib tashlashdi**.

sentences.text: Aziz **is making** good **progress** with his English.
sentences.translation: Azizning ingliz tili yaxshi **rivojlanyapti**.

sentences.text: When I moved to London, I **made** a lot of new **friends**.
sentences.translation: Londonga ko'chganimda ko'plab yangi **do'stlar orttirdim**.

sentences.text: That old car **makes** a strange **noise** when it starts.
sentences.translation: U eski mashina o't olayotganda g'alati **ovoz chiqaradi**.

sentences.text: You can't **make money** without working hard.
sentences.translation: Qattiq mehnat qilmasdan **pul topib** bo'lmaydi.

sentences.text: Our neighbours **made** a big **effort** to keep the street clean.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarimiz ko'chani toza saqlash uchun ko'p **harakat qilishdi**.

examples.title: **do** or **make**? Positive and negative
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: do va make bitta gapda — tasdiq ↔ inkor, savol ↔ javob.

sentences.text: I **did** the shopping, but I **didn't make** dinner.
sentences.translation: **Xarid qildim**, lekin kechki ovqat **tayyorlamadim**.

sentences.text: Madina **makes** very few **mistakes** because she **does** a lot of practice.
sentences.translation: Madina juda kam **xato qiladi**, chunki u ko'p **mashq qiladi**.

sentences.text: **Did** you **make** the bed? — No, but I **did** the washing-up.
sentences.translation: **O'rningni yig'ishtirdingmi**? — Yo'q, lekin **idishlarni yuvdim**.

sentences.text: My brother **does** his homework quickly and then **makes** a lot of phone calls.
sentences.translation: Ukam **uy vazifasini** tez **qiladi**, keyin ko'p **qo'ng'iroq qiladi**.

sentences.text: We **don't make** our own bread, but we **do** all our cooking at home.
sentences.translation: Nonni o'zimiz **yopmaymiz**, lekin hamma **ovqatni** uyda o'zimiz **pishiramiz**.

sentences.text: Sorry, I **made** a mistake — the meeting is on Thursday, not Wednesday.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, **xato qildim** — yig'ilish chorshanba emas, payshanba kuni.

sentences.text: Who **made** all this **noise** last night? — Not me, I **was doing** my homework.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun bu **shovqinni** kim **qildi**? — Men emas, men **uy vazifamni qilayotgan edim**.

sentences.text: Tom **did** a course in photography, and now he **makes** short films.
sentences.translation: Tom fotografiya bo'yicha **kursda o'qidi**, endi u qisqa **filmlar suratga oladi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **has made** a decision: she**'s going to do** a course in Oxford.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza **qaror qildi**: u Oksfordda **kursda o'qimoqchi**.

sentences.text: Who **does** the housework in your home, and who **makes** the decisions?
sentences.translation: Uyingizda **uy ishlarini** kim **qiladi**, **qarorlarni** esa kim **qabul qiladi**?

examples.title: Dialogue: getting ready for guests
examples.description: Suhbatda do va make aralash: do the shopping, make plov, do the cleaning, make a mess, make a phone call, make a noise, do my best.

sentences.text: — The guests are coming at seven. What shall I **do**?
sentences.translation: — Mehmonlar soat yettida keladi. Men nima **qilay**?

sentences.text: — Could you **do the shopping**? We need bread and fruit.
sentences.translation: — **Bozor-o'char qilib kela olasanmi**? Non va meva kerak.

sentences.text: — Sure. Are you going to **make** plov?
sentences.translation: — Albatta. **Palov damlaysanmi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, and I'll **make** a salad and some tea too.
sentences.translation: — Ha, yana salat va choy **tayyorlayman**.

sentences.text: — What about the house? Who's going to **do the cleaning**?
sentences.translation: — Uy-chi? **Uyni** kim **tozalaydi**?

sentences.text: — The children can **do** it. They **made** a terrible **mess** this morning.
sentences.translation: — Bolalar **tozalashadi**. Ular bugun ertalab dahshatli **tartibsizlik qilishdi**.

sentences.text: — OK. I'll also **make a phone call** to Grandma — she wants to come too.
sentences.translation: — Mayli. Buvimga ham **qo'ng'iroq qilaman** — u ham kelmoqchi.

sentences.text: — Good idea. Oh, and please don't **make** any **noise** — the baby's sleeping.
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi fikr. Ha, aytgancha, iltimos, **shovqin qilma** — chaqaloq uxlayapti.

sentences.text: — Don't worry. I**'ll do** my best to be quiet.
sentences.translation: — Xavotir olma. Jim bo'lishga **harakat qilaman**.

sentences.text: — Thanks. You always **make** everything easier for me.
sentences.translation: — Rahmat. Sen doim men uchun hamma narsani **osonlashtirasan**.
